findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 9 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 27 questions numbered 1-27; by section: 9.1 2, 9.2 1, 9.3 2, 9.4 3, 9.5 4, 9.6 2, 9.7 4, 9.8 5, 9.8~2 1, 9.9 3.

17 theory questions (Bronsted-Lowry concept and amphoteric water, conjugate pairs, Lewis adducts, ionic product of water, pH and pOH, Ka, √(Ka C) derivation, common ion effect and its use in salt analysis, buffers and their action, Henderson equation, solubility product, predicting precipitation, salt hydrolysis, indicators, the strong acid-weak base curve, equivalence and end points) and 10 numericals (neutral water at 0 and 40 °C, pH/pOH, [H₃O⁺] of a weak acid, Ka from pH, buffer pH, salt needed for a buffer, solubility from Ksp, Ksp from solubility, predicting precipitation) with new values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: NH₄⁺ conjugate acid, Kw = Kc[H₂O], Table 9.2 powers 10⁻¹⁴, [H⁺] = 10⁻ᵖᴴ, Ka = x²/(C − x), ClO₃⁻, PbSO₄ Ksp 1.6 × 10⁻⁸, S and 2S for Ca(OH)₂, methyl orange red in acid, acid added in the NH₃ titration. Table 9.3's misprinted Ka values and Kw at 100 °C are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
